# RamanD2O

## Introduction

RamanD2O is an R/Shiny application that allows biologists to perform
Raman spectra analysis.

![User interface of RamanD2O](RamanD2O.png)

User interface of RamanD2O

## Quick start

1.  Download and Install R

<https://www.r-project.org>

**Notes:** This app was tested in **R 4.x**. If you are still using R
4.0-4.2, you may need to manually install specifc versions of a few
dependency packages (e.g., randomForest\<4.7, Matrix\<1.7).

2.  Install RamanD2O package

``` r
#install.packages('pak')
pak::pkg_install('gongyh/RamanD2O')
```

3.  Run the R shiny app

``` r
RamanD2O::runRamanD2O()
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`O2PLSvip()`](O2PLSvip.md) : Evaluate the importance of variables in
  O2PLS models
- [`Ramanome-class`](Ramanome-class.md) [`Ramanome`](Ramanome-class.md)
  : Ramanome class
- [`SCRS_preprocess()`](SCRS_preprocess.md) : Preprocess SCRS data
- [`SCRS_toDF()`](SCRS_toDF.md) : load SCRS txt files to dataframe
- [`calOrthVIP()`](calOrthVIP.md) : Calculation of the orthogonal
  variable influence on projection
- [`calPredVIP()`](calPredVIP.md) : Calculation of the predictive
  variable influence on projection
- [`checkInputdata()`](checkInputdata.md) : Check if input data
  satisfies input conditions
- [`eemddenoise()`](eemddenoise.md) : Denosing using EEMD method
- [`findPeaks()`](findPeaks.md) : search peaks for each spectrum
- [`get.nearest.dataset()`](get.nearest.dataset.md) : Get the nearest
  dataset from a Ramanome object
- [`hvd()`](hvd.md) : Hilbert Vibration Decomposition
- [`ilpf()`](ilpf.md) : Ideal Lowpass Filter
- [`inst()`](inst.md) : Instantaneous Properties
- [`length(`*`<Ramanome>`*`)`](length-Ramanome-method.md) : Length
  method for Ramanome objects
- [`rbind2(`*`<Ramanome>`*`,`*`<Ramanome>`*`)`](rbind2-Ramanome-Ramanome-method.md)
  : \#' Plot method for Ramanome objects \#' \#' @param x The Ramanome
  object \#' @param y Character specifying the plot type \#' @importFrom
  hyperSpec plot \#' @importFrom hyperSpec print \#' @importFrom methods
  setMethod
- [`removeCosmic()`](removeCosmic.md) : remove cosmic rays for each
  spectrum
- [`runRamanD2O()`](runRamanD2O.md) : Run RamanD2O Shiny App
- [`show(`*`<Ramanome>`*`)`](show-Ramanome-method.md) : Show method for
  Ramanome objects This method will give brief information about the
  Ramanome object
- [`ssd()`](ssd.md) : estimation of the sum of squares of deviations
- [`` `[`( ``*`<Ramanome>`*`,`*`<ANY>`*`,`*`<ANY>`*`,`*`<ANY>`*`)`](sub-Ramanome-ANY-ANY-ANY-method.md)
  : Subset method for Ramanome objects
- [`synchdem()`](synchdem.md) : Synchronous Demodulation
